title: Driving Rules Explainer
brief: Every event kind and its rule: signals, thresholds, debounce, hysteresis, cooldowns, severity and confidence, the per-asset toggles and the resync, and why speed-delta harsh rules need 5 Hz or more (off on 1 Hz devices). Use the numbers in the brief exactly.

title: Driver Score Formula
brief: The weights, the formula with the 10 km floor, the bands, the 2 km minimum (too_short), provisional scores, pending reviews held out, and the worked example (penalty 110 over 38.4 km is 71, needs attention).

title: Speed Limit Sources and Overspeed Review
brief: The three limit sources, limitAgeS, held and stale limits re-judged against the assumed urban 50 km/h (keep only over 55), implausible limits under 20 km/h dropped, what low confidence means, and how a reviewer keeps or drops an event.

title: Device Command Preconditions
brief: Each command, the 60 s queue TTL (clamped to 120 s), the online requirement (409), OBD scan errors (400, 429 with retryAfterMs), 502 publish failures, duplicate request ids, reboot timing (about 90 s) and that power-off is not remotely recoverable.

title: Event Inbox Outcome Glossary
brief: The six outcome classes with examples, the retry schedule (8 attempts over about 44 hours), why a run stays started while its delivery is pending, deduplication, and the ignored reasons.

title: Roles and Permissions
brief: The viewer, operator, admin and owner matrix on the stricter side, why the fleet app and the device platform disagreed and which side Kestrelway took, the three commands that always need approval, the audit log, and that the dev console user acts as an admin.

title: Session Insights Reference
brief: Every insight field (duration, distance, speed, stops, vehicle, deviceStatus), recordedMs versus totalMs, the 2 km/h moving threshold, the distance filters, stops of 60 s or more, and the rule to quote numbers exactly.

title: OBD Tiers and Vehicle Data
brief: Full, basic and none tiers, the signals each gives, which rules each tier supports (none: only overspeed-gps and no OBD scan), and how the vehicle insight block depends on the tier.

title: Device Status and Health Flags
brief: The LED states and what each means, the health flags (under_voltage, gps_weak_fix, lte_down, throttled, storage_low) with a likely cause and first action for each, and what last_seen and agent_version tell the desk.

title: Webhook Signing and Secret Rotation
brief: How deliveries are signed and checked, the rotation procedure (the platform signs with the new secret at once, so update the receiver in the same change), the 401 signature_mismatch symptom, and the fix: new secret in the receiver, redeliver failed deliveries (owner or admin), resync rules.

title: Device Data Purge Procedure
brief: Who may purge, the three scopes, the ordered steps, the preview counts, the approval as the confirmation, the statuses to poll, the 409 errors, and that a purge cannot be undone.

title: SMS Inbox Handling
brief: What lands in a device modem's SMS inbox, why message text and numbers are personal data, that the desk gives counts only and never reads messages out, who may view them in the device console, and that clearing is irreversible and needs approval.
